RESEARCH-ACTIVE at international level: has authored and co-authored peer-reviewed articles in the Indian Heart Journal, JACC (Journal of the American College of Cardiology), JAPI and Advances in Interventional Cardiology, on drug-eluting stents, coronary artery dissection, renal sympathetic denervation, oxidative stress and indigenous stent technology - a JACC credit is a strong international standing marker; he also appears as a co-author on published work on radiofrequency catheter ablation in hypertrophic obstructive cardiomyopathy. ACADEMIC HONOURS confirmed on this row's search: recommended for the award of 'Gold Medal in General Medicine (M.D)' for 2001 for the state of Andhra Pradesh, and awarded 'Best Outgoing Student' by the Indian Medical Association from Osmania Medical College for 1997. Premium high-capex specialty: interventional cardiology cath-lab practice (primary angioplasty, complex coronary and peripheral intervention, device implantation). Training: MBBS Osmania Medical College (1997), MD General Medicine Gandhi Medical College (2001), DNB Cardiology, National Board of Examinations (2005). Listed on the Government of India's Advantage Healthcare directory of India-facing specialist consultants.

Every other field in the two source rows is identical - same name, same department 'Cardiology', same hospital 'AIG Hospital', same city, same (blank) experience. The duplication is a branch-column artifact in the workbook, not two doctors. CORRECTION TO ROW 1253's NOTE: that file speculated the second occurrence was 'attributed to a different hospital'. Having now read the source data directly, that is NOT the case - the second occurrence is the SAME hospital group (AIG Hospital) and the SAME specialty (Cardiology), differing only in the branch label. Row 1253's caution about unrelated Menons in Indian medicine remains sound in general but does not apply to this pair. PROVENANCE OF THIS ROW'S CONTENT: the URLs, role, experience and HNI signals here were CARRIED ACROSS from the already-completed paired row 1253 rather than independently rediscovered; only the confirmation search below was run fresh. CONFIRMATION SEARCH RUN FOR THIS ROW: a WebSearch for '"Dr. Rajeev Menon" AIG Hospitals cardiologist Hyderabad' returned exactly one such clinician - Dr. Rajeev Vijay Kumar Menon, Consultant Cardiologist at AIG Hospital Hyderabad, 28 years' experience, MBBS Osmania Medical College 1997, MD General Medicine Gandhi Medical College 2001, DNB Cardiology 2005, publications in the Indian Heart Journal, JACC, JAPI and Advances in Interventional Cardiology - matching name + specialty + hospital + city and matching row 1253's recorded facts exactly. BRANCH CAVEAT FOR A HUMAN: this row's address column says Banjara Hills, but every public source places him at the GACHIBOWLI campus (published address: Plot no 2/3/4/5, Survey No 136/1, Mindspace Road, Gachibowli).
